description: This file contains declarations for sanitization and escaping functions used in the libwebsockets project, specifically for handling SQL and JSON string purification, filename sanitization, and platform-specific file operations.

methods.name: lws_sql_purify
methods.description: Escapes input string for safe SQL usage, similar to strncpy but with escape sequences for quotes.

methods.name: lws_sql_purify_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the input string after SQL escaping without performing the escape.

methods.name: lws_json_purify
methods.description: Escapes input string for safe JSON usage, similar to strncpy but with escape sequences for special characters.

methods.name: lws_json_purify_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the JSON escaped version of the input string without performing the escape.

methods.name: lws_filename_purify_inplace
methods.description: Replaces dangerous characters in a filename with underscores to make it safe.

methods.name: lws_plat_write_cert
methods.description: Platform-specific function to write a certificate or key to a file descriptor.

methods.name: lws_plat_write_file
methods.description: Writes a buffer to a specified filename on disk.

methods.name: lws_plat_read_file
methods.description: Reads data from a specified filename into a buffer.

methods.name: lws_plat_recommended_rsa_bits
methods.description: Returns recommended RSA key size in bits for platform.
